Method of Attack: Exploitation of internet-exposed and insecure SonarQube instances
Use of default admin/admin credentials to gain access
Scanning for Internet-exposed SonarQube instances on default port 9000
Exfiltration of proprietary source code and confidential documents
Publishing stolen source code on public repositories
Impacted Systems: Private U.S. companies in technology, finance, retail, food, eCommerce, and manufacturing sectors
Attack Vector: Internet-exposed SonarQube instances with default settings
